professionalSummary.text: Led delivery of a platform migration for 38,000 private-client accounts onto a vendor wealth-management platform at Ashgrove Investment Partners from April 2020 to July 2024.
professionalSummary.witness: Programme manager at Ashgrove Investment Partners from April 2020 to July 2024, delivery lead for moving 38,000 private-client accounts onto a vendor wealth-management platform.

professionalSummary.text: Approved scope changes of up to ten person-days under delegated authority as specified in the programme charter, escalating larger changes to the executive sponsor with an options paper.
professionalSummary.witness: Approved scope changes of up to ten person-days under the delegated authority set out in the programme charter, and took larger changes to the executive sponsor with an options paper.

professionalSummary.text: Chaired weekly milestone reviews with the platform vendor and data-conversion contractor, recording slippage against the contract schedule and agreeing recovery dates.
professionalSummary.witness: Chaired the weekly milestone review with the platform vendor and the data-conversion contractor, recording slippage against the contract schedule and agreeing recovery dates.

professionalSummary.text: Made the go decision for the final migration weekend in March 2024 against the charter's cutover criteria, with the decision entered in the decision log and countersigned by the executive sponsor.
professionalSummary.witness: Made the go decision for the final migration weekend in March 2024 against the charter's cutover criteria; the decision is entered in the decision log and countersigned by the executive sponsor.

professionalSummary.text: Wrote the timeline and frequently-asked-questions sections of the client-communication plan, which the marketing team prepared and owned.
